inspection.method: Every Africa location geometry, actual pinned source member and named original source parent was inspected. Area/overlap uses the existing precise WGS84 surface integral. inspection.source_file_hashes_note: Cache source bytes are verified by these local SHA-256 values; pinned public source URLs and their licenses/vintages are separately recorded in decision evidence. A cache digest is not asserted to equal every published full/simplified download digest.
